normalization.text: Convert non-breaking spaces to ASCII spaces, collapse repeated whitespace, and trim leading and trailing whitespace.
normalization.numbers: Retain the stored workbook values at full precision with no rounding.
normalization.missing_shape: Represent source NA or empty fish plotting shapes as blank CSV values.
normalization.unchanged: Preserve source row order, names, group labels, panel labels, and the deposited Non-avian Reptillia spelling.

metric_contract.scope: Published natural-log Shannon and Gini-Simpson diversity over the top 10 TE superfamilies.
metric_contract.published_top10_reclosure: Unresolved in the article and Figure 2 deposit; the workbook supplies final diversity values rather than component abundances.

acceptance_decision: Accept the exact 84-row Dryad Figure 2 workbook as the published source. Reject the historical rounded 87-row local composite as a publication source; it is not the deposited Figure 2 sample.
